description: Source code for a plugin system managing services, dynamic objects, and plugin loading in a device management context.

classes.name: service
classes.description: Represents a service with name, parent device management, and object identifier.

methods.name: add_service_to_main_tree
methods.description: Adds a service to the main device management tree, allocating dynamic objects as needed.

methods.name: is_service_registered
methods.description: Checks if a service with a given name is already registered in the service list.

methods.name: add_service_to_list
methods.description: Adds a new service to the service list.

methods.name: free_services_from_list
methods.description: Frees all services from a linked list.

methods.name: load_service
methods.description: Loads a service into the main device management structure and service list.

methods.name: ubus_transaction_callback
methods.description: Callback for handling UBUS transaction responses, updating service info.

methods.name: handle_transaction_of_registered_service
methods.description: Handles UBUS transactions for registered services, optionally restarting services.

methods.name: get_list_of_registered_service
methods.description: Populates a blob buffer with the list of registered services.

methods.name: free_all_dynamic_nodes
methods.description: Recursively frees dynamic nodes within a device management object.

methods.name: plugin_obj_match
methods.description: Checks if a plugin object matches a given parameter.

methods.name: dm_check_dynamic_obj
methods.description: Checks dynamic objects against a full object path.

methods.name: dm_check_dynamic_obj_entry
methods.description: Checks a single dynamic object entry against a full object path.

methods.name: find_entry_obj
methods.description: Finds a dynamic object entry matching a given object path.

methods.name: disable_entry_obj
methods.description: Disables a specific object entry within a device management object.

methods.name: dm_exclude_obj
methods.description: Excludes an object from a device management object based on a path.

methods.name: get_entry_idx
methods.description: Returns the index of an entry object.

methods.name: get_obj_idx
methods.description: Returns the index of an array of entry objects.

methods.name: get_leaf_idx
methods.description: Returns the index of an array of leaf objects.

methods.name: load_plugins
methods.description: Loads plugin files (.json and .so) from a specified directory.

methods.name: free_plugins
methods.description: Frees all plugin-related dynamic data and resources.
